title: Full-Text Search Capabilities
description: Interactive p5.js MicroSim that runs a real full-text search over a five-document corpus. Students toggle case folding, Porter stemming, phrase matching, proximity search, and wildcards, see every matching word highlighted by match type, and watch precision, recall, and F1 change.
creator: Dan McCreary
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Conversational AI

educational.learningObjective: Compare how full-text search features change the documents a query retrieves and analyze the trade-off between precision and recall.
learningObjectives: Compare the effect of case folding, stemming, phrase matching, proximity search, and wildcards on query results
Analyze how a feature that raises recall can lower precision
Calculate precision, recall, and F1 for a set of retrieved documents

controls.label: Query
controls.purpose: The search query; results update as you type

controls.label: Stemming
controls.purpose: Match words that share a Porter stem

controls.label: Phrase
controls.purpose: Require the query words side by side, in order

controls.label: Wildcards (* ?)
controls.purpose: Treat * and ? in the query as wildcards

controls.label: Proximity
controls.purpose: Require the query words within N words of each other

simulation.modelType: Boolean AND retrieval over a positional index
simulation.informationNeed: How do I back up a database?
assumptions: Title and body are indexed as one stream of word positions
A document matches only when every query word is found
Relevance judgments are fixed for one information need and do not change with the query
